fold_choice: Predeclared development pilot: largest distinct issue/day support in the training-only v5 audit; no seed search or automatic fold expansion
mechanism: Freeze existing NumericContext and the v5 observed-quality case bank; train only a zero-initialized bounded increment relative to NumericContext, with exact zero increment outside knowledge support
ablation: Identical incremental module, seed, masks, inputs, fit labels, parameters and optimizer; only its typed Wiki memory tokens are zeroed. Not a retrained or replaced numerical baseline
fit: Same donor1-5 memory plus calibration_early windows as v5; before bank maturity overlap/tokens are zero and the incremental output is exactly zero
selection: Original first half of calibration_late, donors only; select among epochs jointly no worse than unchanged NumericContext MAE and RMSE, average ratios, epoch0 fallback
benefit_calibration: Same disjoint second half of calibration_late after both candidate checkpoints freeze; keep v5 utility thresholds unchanged and bind each new certificate to its actual execution
required_preflight: GPU-idle strict v5 calibration input/output SHA256 replay; report training-only supported-candidate oracle headroom and issue-day gain variability; if hashes disagree stop rather than bypass. If supported oracle headroom is zero stop without fitting
numerical_control: Reuse byte-identical v5 NoWikiUnchanged cached outer predictions; do not train, preprocess or replace NumericContext, OriginalTrend, scaler or raw power labels
case_bank: Reuse the exact v5 quality_expert.json, no changes to neighbor support, event thresholds, capacity/rotation matching or pitch rules
time_evidence: Report distinct issue counts, UTC day concentration and blockwise signs; day blocks are not assumed independent. No new time threshold is fitted from outer validation. Time-support gating is a separate future ablation, not silently added here
evaluation: One historically inspected development outer validation report after both arms and certificates freeze; no claim of independent confirmation; sealed test never inferred
primary_success: WikiIncrementSelective must improve both MAE and RMSE over unchanged NumericContext and its matched ZeroMemoryIncrementSelective ablation; otherwise no demonstrated Wiki accuracy contribution
known_limitations: A supported-case increment may still have weak candidates or insufficient temporal calibration. Extra capacity is explicitly tested by zero-memory ablation; exact expert hashes do not prove temporal transportability. Cannot repair unchanged numeric errors outside Wiki support.
